reason: The v1 execution froze the open-text decoder and decoded tokens after per-row EOS, yielding exact-zero scores. V2 trains the decoder for every method and pads each row after its first EOS.
source_checkpoint_policy: freeze the exactly paired validation-selected A1 T2-b BERT-base reader; initialize the open-text head from that checkpoint and train it as common task infrastructure

operator_input.representation: the frozen T2-b reader's pooled [address; replacement] instruction
operator_input.o2: ungated rank-16 additive residual from [slot; instruction]

training.records: accepted com2_intervention and com2_counterfactual records plus deterministic factual-restoration exposure at every chain position
training.objective: equal-weight changed-event and preserved-event teacher-forced open-text cross entropy

baselines.prompting: frozen reader with full attention over the ordered combined command; addressed editor bypassed; open-text head trained on the same train records
baselines.lora_matched: query/value LoRA plus open-text head; deterministic LoRA rank minimizing distance to the instantiated textual O3 parameter count; same open-text objective

selection: fixed step 500; no validation-driven hyperparameter or checkpoint selection

evaluation.truth: 70 independently double-annotated and adjudicated ordered Com2 pairs
